4-layer: L2/L3 embedded spiral coil 2 x 40 turns, 0.2 mm tr…
1. DXF outlines aon_board_81_mm/_in.dxf and aon_panel_E06_mm/_in.dxf in dxf/ import straight into KiCad Edge.Cuts (origin = satellite axis for the 81 board, panel centre-bottom for
2. Board fab (all): IPC-6012 Class 3 (space addendum IPC-6012DS where the vendor supports it), Tg ≥ 170 °C, ENIG, no via-in-pad unfilled, 1 oz outer / 1 oz inner minimum, coupons
3. Assembly: IPC J-STD-001 with space addendum (J-STD-001xS), no-clean flux removed, conformal coat Arathane 5750 / CV-1152 except connectors and the torquer test pads.
4. Mounting holes are not plated; the chassis ground ring on the mounting face bonds board ground to the frame through the spacer (one-point ground at E01).
5. Stack bus: ESQ-126-39-G-D (BP-05) at the same X/Y on every stack board; pin allocation in AON-E01.
